author: syvai
description:
Synthetic passport-style photos
	

This manually gated dataset contains the synthetic-image corpus used for the
experiment-91 interim-84 v6 classifier. It has 23,745 train and 1,124 dev
photos. The dev split is the model-selection validation split, not an independent
owner test set. No citizen photos or owner-test images are included.
Each row has the exact image bytes, a SHA-256 image ID, source (the generating
model or source dataset), source_detail (the original frozen source… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/syvai/danish-passport-photos-synthetic.
